03A memory device: the determinant

A memory device: write:

Explanation (added)

This is expansion of a determinant along its first row; the signs go . It is called a “memory device” because the top row holds vectors rather than numbers, so it is not a determinant in the strict sense — but expanding it as if it were one reproduces exactly the three components found above.

09Properties of the cross product

Properties

For all , and all scalars :

Explanation (added)

Property 6 runs off the edge of the photo after “”; the ending shown here, , is the standard form of this identity (Stewart §12.4, property 6). Properties 3 and 4 are both needed because order matters: you can distribute from the left or from the right, but you must keep each product in its original order. Property 5 is the scalar triple product, which the next lecture (12.5 notes) interprets as the volume of a parallelepiped.
